Title: Resurf: A Personal Context Library for Mac | Product Hunt
# Resurf. ## A Personal Context Library for Mac. ## Similar Products. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. I’m a design engineer and maker of Resurf. I save a lot of things while working. They ended up scattered across apps, and I rarely came back to them. So I built Resurf for myself. It’s a **personal context app** for things you like, care about, and work on. Search when you need something. **Use that context with AI:** ask your library inside Resurf, or hand it off to your AI tools through MCP and CLI. I’ve shared earlier versions on Reddit, and the feedback helped shape the app. It’s now fully native on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Your library lives locally, with optional private iCloud sync. Free to try on Mac. Free on iPhone and iPad. One-time purchase for unlimited Mac use. Would love to hear your thoughts and what you’d use it for 🙂. @deep\_lakhani is this beginning of the end for traditional note-taking apps ? the CLI and MCP supported are a nice touch for the people who already use the ai tools and also i like that the library stays local with optional iCloud sync. I use this app every single day, and couldn't go back. It permanently lives in my menu bar, and I store every single bit of inspiration I find! Whenever I'm designing anything, the first place I start is my Resurf library. Really appreciate you using Resurf every day, sharing feedback, and helping me make it better 🙌🏻. Love getting feedback from people who care about craft as much i do. I gave it a try and its smooth. I was using obsidian for achieving same things. I'll post another review after 30 days, hoping for the best. @piyush\_jaiswal3 Thank for giving it try! Feel free to send your feedback. Love the idea of making a personal library useful context for AI! Can you limit MCP access to specific spaces or collections? @deep\_lakhani the local storage and private icloud sync bit caught me, esp for a context library. curious, is search still fully local when icloud sync is off?
